channel.title: The Vicksburg Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Vicksburg Post (vicksburgpost.com)

item.title: Wilson on too close to call vote: 'We are waiting patiently with you'
item.description: Kevin Wilson trails Ron Eller by 442 votes in Mississippi’s 2nd District GOP primary and says he and supporters are waiting patiently as remaining ballots are counted.

item.title: ‘It takes a village’: Play Pals program brings families together
item.description: I Can Fly Ministries hosts Bridge Club launch Saturday in Vicksburg to connect children with special needs and the community.

item.title: Titans players picked for all-star tournament in West Virginia
item.description: Port Gibson Titans lineman Myakel Collins, and linebackers Albert Dotson Jr. and Sydney Ryals, were selected to play in the D1 Nation Spring Battle in the Mountains scheduled for March 21-22 in Dunbar, West Virginia.

item.title: Alice Lee Brown Moore
item.description: Visitation for Alice Lee Brown Moore will be held on March 14

item.title: Vikings tie one, lose one at the Battle at the Beach
item.description: Ryan Steed homered for Warren Central, but the Vikings lost to Class 7A power Tupelo at the Battle at the Beach baseball event Thursday in Biloxi.

item.title: January 2026 grand jury returns 25 indictments in cases from murder to DUI
item.description: January 2026 grand jury returns 25 indictments ranging from two murder cases and rape to child abuse, kidnapping, drug and DUI charges, burglary, armed robbery and felony shoplifting.

item.title: VTG to celebrate 90 years of 'Gold in the Hills'
item.description: Vicksburg Theater Guild marks 90 years of "Gold in the Hills" with a celebration at Parkside Playhouse, featuring children’s activities, performances, food vendors, a documentary screening and prizes.

item.title: Eight Garters Later
item.description: When Nicholas Benjamin (Nick) Wright attended a wedding, fellow bachelors knew their chances of catching the bridal garter were slim to none. Before he married, Nick had caught the time-honored wedding accessory eight times.

item.title: Madison advances to LHSAA basketball championship game
item.description: The Madison Jaguars beat Green Oaks in the LHSAA Division III Non-Select boys basketball semifinals on Thursday, to advance to their first state title game since 2007.

item.title: Ole Miss upsets Georgia to reach SEC quarterfinals
item.description: 15th-seeded Ole Miss continued a surprising run at the SEC men's basketball tournament by beating Georgia 76-72 on Friday.
